conclusions.privilegedLabel: D_ONE_STEP, D_H2-D_H4, D_OPTION, D_SEARCH_*, PLANNER_* and every CAD / CR / DDV figure are PRIVILEGED_UPPER_BOUNDS from the simulator; only NEW_LINEAR, NEW_INTERACTION and D_OBS_OPTION read deployable inputs

disclosures.PRIVILEGED: D_ONE_STEP, D_H2-D_H4, D_OPTION, D_SEARCH_*, PLANNER_* and every CAD / CR / DDV figure are PRIVILEGED_UPPER_BOUNDS from the simulator; only NEW_LINEAR, NEW_INTERACTION and D_OBS_OPTION read deployable inputs
disclosures.PRIMARY_MODELS: Stage 3G.3 fitted models reused byte for byte (fitted on levels 0-1 DEV rows); the level-balanced refits are SECONDARY
disclosures.DEPTH3: PLANNER_D3 on every 16th eligible row only
disclosures.SEARCH_DEPTH1_EQUALS_H2: a depth-1 exhaustive search value equals the H2 truncated oracle return by construction (the greedy continuation already takes the one-step maximum), so D_SEARCH_D1 duplicates D_H2 and the D_H2 vs D_SEARCH_D1 comparison is trivially null; the informative bounded-search controls are DEPTH_2 (every row) and DEPTH_3 (subsample)
disclosures.ORACLE: no Oracle-expert evidence is produced; ORACLE_TEMPORAL_MODELLING_ON_CRITICAL_PATH answers whether temporal modelling is on the critical path
